The disjoint classification gives the closed complete polynomial. Single-vertex extension tests prove precisely the two maximal families. value.rationale: Complete induced-forest and maximal-forest enumerators answer exact configuration-counting questions on a canonical connected (n-1)-regular bipartite graph. Beyond determining the maximum forest order, the classification reveals an unbounded gap n-4 between largest and smallest inclusion-maximal forests for n>=5, and the dual gap for inclusion-minimal feedback vertex sets. That obstruction is invisible to classical maximum-size statements and captures the failure of maximality as an optimization proxy.
